units.source_text: 我给道子的信写了如下内容：

en.t: In my letter to Michiko, I wrote the following:

units.source_text: 下月（十月）八日我们要到名古屋作毕业旅行，将就便去岐阜一行。

en.t: Next month, on October 8, we will go to Nagoya for our graduation trip, and while we are there we will also make a side trip to Gifu.

units.source_text: 届时会面，我想跟你谈谈你的终身大事。

en.t: When we meet then, I want to talk with you about your future marriage.

units.source_text: 在这之前，在家里无论遇到什么事情，你都得忍耐，不要吵架。

en.t: Until then, no matter what happens at home, you must endure it and not quarrel.

units.source_text: 实在待不下去，非要出走到东京来不可，就一定给我来封电报，我去接你。

en.t: If you truly cannot stay there and have no choice but to run away to Tokyo, be sure to send me a telegram, and I will come to meet you.

units.source_text: 要是你一人来东京，不要到别人家里，径直到朝仓或我这里来吧。

en.t: If you come to Tokyo alone, do not go to anyone else's house; come straight to Asakura's place or to mine.

units.source_text: 这件事，你可千万要记住呀。

en.t: You must be absolutely sure to remember this.

units.source_text: 你读完这封信，立即撕毁，或者付诸一炬吧。

en.t: After you finish reading this letter, tear it up at once, or burn it.
